basis: stated access and linkage geometry estimates; no OEM dimensions measured

board.fixed_to: table with four through-bolts or equivalent clamps; table stiffness qualification required

axis: installed local x, yawed68.60717 degrees about world z

load.spring_product: 5 x MISUMI SWF25-50 in parallel; 19.6 N/mm each; 25 mm OD, 13.5 mm ID, 50 mm free length
load.cable_product: Loos GC18879M 3/16 inch commercial galvanized 7x19 cable, 4200 lbf minimum breaking strength

cartridge.guide_rods: four M8 steel rods at (+/-40,+/-40) through endplates
cartridge.spring_guides: five 12 mm diameter steel guide pins at spring centres
cartridge.preload_adjustment: M8 guided carriage adjuster offset from central spring; qualify with handle force gauge

load.termination_requirement: Professionally swaged thimbled eyes; assembled certified working load >= 2.5 kN after termination efficiency and at least 5:1 strength factor. Reject uncertified cable ends.
load.anchor_requirement: Two M8 class 8.8 bolts per steel cartridge endplate through steel backing plate; anchored board/table connection qualified to >= 2.5 kN cable tension and 100 N m bracket torque.

calibration_instrument.installation: Inline in the horizontal cable route, housing supported without axial shunt; adjust complete assembled spring curve. Read kg*9.80665 N. No physical calibration performed.

fabrication: Anchor 18 mm floor board on 104.5 mm anchored risers to the table. Bolt OEM bracket through board using original mounting holes. Key the two adapter blocks onto exposed 12 x 26 mm steel bar at 100 and 150 mm radii, not onto the rubber grip. Attach offset spine and named 200 mm RRS handle. Leave stock button and its entire 8 mm travel unobstructed. Install all seat and console envelopes with listed local dimensions and full yawed geometry; they do not assist lever motion. Loading spring cartridge has fixed steel reaction plates and qualified cable ends.
qualification: Unmeasured fixture proposal; maker spring and cable specifications verified. Five SWF25-50 springs have 22.165 mm compression at 36 deg below 25 mm; 3/16 inch GC18879M cable replaces underspecified 1/8 inch. Qualify complete terminated route at all listed angles before real trials.

extension.maker_intended_use: RRS hydraulic handbrake; fitting to the Yaris requires the custom adapter below and is not maker-approved compatibility

adapter.material: 6061 aluminum split blocks and 20 x 20 mm spine; standard stock
adapter.block_fasteners: two M6 class 8.8 screws per split block, counterbored outside the lever; transfer actual purchased bar section
adapter.extension_connection: split collet around actual 30 mm estimated base; transfer measured purchased diameter/thread before machining, without drilling the OEM lever
adapter.qualification: 100 N m about pivot and500 N transverse without slip or deformation; physical proof not performed

coating.enrollment: dry pair must sustain112 N tangential traction under80 N total normal load; no measurement yet
coating.material_combination: Explicit max combination for estimated pair1.6/1.4; robot pad materials unchanged
coating.basis: 3M trial-bag TDS: matedGM613/TB614 dry kinetic2.8, wet2.6. Not synthetic-leather or YAM data. Model1.6/1.4 remains an unmeasured pair estimate; physical traction qualification required.
